CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to identified content is present.

COD.rationale: Content (p0/current/n0 red), its presentation/organization (grid orientation and explicit coordinate set) and a separate origin/status entry are all explicitly present for the same referent and time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition statement bound to the identified contents' presentation/access.

C.rationale: The report explicitly names represented contents (grid-coordinate sets) with attributes (red/blue) for current entries.

D.rationale: Origins/status fields explicitly distinguish content identity records (copied_prior_record) from estimated/history-derived records (history_estimate) for current referents.

O.rationale: The text describes how contents are presented/organized (grid orientation and explicit coordinate sets) for current entries.
